purpose: Port only the raw-observable SNR and adjacent residual portions of the pinned upstream preprocessing into the opt-in native FGO graph.

source.raw_only_geometry: Satellite position, velocity, and elevation are computed from broadcast navigation and native seed geometry. SvPosition*, SvElevationDegrees, receiver/WLS coordinates, and any precomputed trajectory are ignored.

exobs_residuals.m.ported: elevation/D residual, two-sided adjacent dDP/dDL masks, global system residual center, and fixed thresholds
exobs_residuals.m.not_ported: base-observation compensation and MATLAB table/state objects

obserrmodel.m.ported: midpoint MATLAB percentile p85, sn_den=20, signal factors, P=scale*factor and D=scale/12
obserrmodel.m.not_ported: upstream L sigma because Phase12 ordinary TDCP sigma is frozen at 0.03 m

parameters.m.lines: phone preset and observation-mask parameter definitions
parameters.m.ported: p85, denominator, 5 degree elevation, P/D/L thresholds and 1.5 second continuity
parameters.m.note: This audit reads .m source as specification only; no MATLAB .mat is opened or generated.

fixed_observable_contract.snr_percentile_convention: MATLAB prctile midpoint rank 0.5+n*p/100 with endpoint clipping

sigma.carrier_tdcp: Phase12 frozen 0.03 m; no upstream L reweighting

adjacent_masks.device_offsets: upstream carrier offsets are applied only by the existing raw carrier helper; this pixel7pro recipe has empty device model

residual_masks.doppler: per-epoch median native receiver-only residual; reject abs(residual-median)>3 m/s
residual_masks.pseudorange: global (clock group,band) median of native SPP-seed residual; reject abs(residual-median)>20 m (L1) or 15 m (L5)
residual_masks.center_provenance: raw/nav-only native SPP seed; this is explicitly not a truth-fitted or upstream-MAT center

fixed_observable_contract.base_compensation: not used; required base observation is outside the raw Android GNSS+nav contract
fixed_observable_contract.graph_application: P/D masks and sigmas are applied before final problem factor creation; candidate-quality receiver-only D rows are also inserted into the IMU velocity+clock-drift graph.

raw_observable_descriptives.note: These are truth-free raw CN0 descriptives, not a fitted threshold.

audit_record_hash: excluded from self-hash; the companion freeze manifest fixes this file SHA256
